query:
The group settled on a Peckham birthday night for Zara. What did one member's response to that plan reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Priya
C. Dom
D. Kezia
context:
[1] (about=Dom, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:20:00) Yeah yeah I know. Not happy about it but I know. Anyway, let's talk about something else before I depress myself completely. Zara isn't your birthday coming up?
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:21:00) okay so YES October 4th and I have been trying not to make a big deal of it but actually I would love to do something with all of you 🥳 like dinner and then out in Peckham? There's that bar near the Bussey Building that opened this summer 🍹🎶
[3] (about=Kezia, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:22:00) YES Zara this is exactly what we should do, dinner and then out in Peckham is perfect 🎉 I'm already excited, October 4th is a Saturday yes? That's ideal 🙌
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:23:00) I'm in. We should do dinner somewhere good first and then the bar. Zara you deserve a proper celebration, honestly the thing is you hold this group together more than you know.
[5] (about=Marcus, episodic, t6 @2025-09-22T19:27:00) Honestly, the thing is an Asanka dinner and then that bar sounds like a proper Saturday. Let's do it. Zara go ahead and book Asanka before we talk ourselves out of it.
[6] (about=Kezia, episodic, t0 @2025-09-01T19:19:00) Zara yes, group dinner, I second this completely 🙌 Marcus what do you think, could you actually host? Or is the restaurant still giving you nothing? Bless you for even surviving August.
[7] (about=Kezia, episodic, t6 @2025-09-22T19:23:00) Asanka for me! 🙌 New experience, Zara's birthday, feels right. Also how many people are we? Someone mentioned work friends might join for the bar part afterward?
[8] (about=Zara, episodic, t7 @2025-09-29T19:22:00) okay so birthday week is nearly here and I'm SO excited but also I have been having a weird few days, I watched this documentary that Marcus's sourcing conversations made me think about and honestly I can't stop thinking about it 😬🌿
[9] (about=Kezia, episodic, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Zara what documentary? What kind of weird few days are we talking? 🤔 Bless, spill it.
[10] (about=Zara, episodic, t6 @2025-09-22T19:25:00) okay so the dinner is just us six, I wouldn't do that to Marcus and Priya on a Saturday 😂 but a couple of my work friends might join us at the bar after, nothing massive, like three or four extra people max 🥂
agent_answer:
C. Dom

Dom’s response — **“Yeah yeah I know. Not happy about it but I know.”** — reveals that although he went along with the agreed Peckham plan, his actual position was reluctant/resentful: he was **not happy about it**, but resigned to it (“but I know”).

query:
The group agreed on an Ethiopian restaurant for Zara's birthday dinner. What did one member's response to that decision reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in their phrasing signals this?

Options:
A. Felix
B. Dom
C. Priya
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-09-29T19:41:00) Ethiopian is fine.
[2] (about=Felix, episodic, t8 @2025-09-29T19:42:00) If that is the consensus.
[3] (about=Felix, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:20:00) It was tolerable. I prefer actual cheese. The tradition of this group ending the year with plans we may or may not follow through on is not a new one, is it Priya.
[4] (about=Felix, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:18:00) I remain skeptical of the cashew cheese trend, Zara.
[5] (about=Zara, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:19:00) Felix you tried some at the Ethiopian dinner and said nothing!! Did you actually hate it? 😂🌱
[6] (about=Kezia, episodic, t0 @2025-09-01T19:19:00) Zara yes, group dinner, I second this completely 🙌 Marcus what do you think, could you actually host? Or is the restaurant still giving you nothing? Bless you for even surviving August.
[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t6 @2025-09-22T19:27:00) Honestly, the thing is an Asanka dinner and then that bar sounds like a proper Saturday. Let's do it. Zara go ahead and book Asanka before we talk ourselves out of it.
[8] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:23:00) I'm in. We should do dinner somewhere good first and then the bar. Zara you deserve a proper celebration, honestly the thing is you hold this group together more than you know.
[9] (about=Dom, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:11:00) Priya enjoyed a birthday. Felix played football. Marcus simplified a menu. Dom did yoga. The world has fully shifted tbh 😂
[10] (about=Zara, episodic, t8 @2025-09-29T19:34:00) okay so honestly? the cheese. giving up cheese is going to be a whole thing. I've been vegetarian for years but I always had a bit of a cheese problem 😂 the documentary just made the dairy thing feel like something I can't unknow anymore. Marcus those sourcing conversations we had after the dinner, that's what sent me down the rabbit hole 🌱🐄
agent_answer:
A. Felix.

Felix’s response to the Ethiopian restaurant decision was: **“If that is the consensus.”**

That phrasing reveals his actual position: he wasn’t genuinely enthusiastic about the choice — he was only going along with it conditionally, deferring to the group rather than endorsing the restaurant himself. The word “if” signals that his agreement wasn’t wholehearted; he’d accept it only because it was the group’s decision.
